zh.title: Aeroregional 737-500 降落厄瓜多聖羅莎時偏出跑道
zh.summary: Aeroregional 6G-853 航班降落時在跑道右側停下，機上65人，報導未傳傷亡。
body: 據 The Aviation Herald 報導，厄瓜多航空公司 Aeroregional 的6G-853航班於11月20日晚間在聖羅莎機場降落時偏出跑道。這架由基多出發的波音737-500註冊號為 HC-CTF，機上共有65人。
報導指出，航機在雷雨期間於25跑道落地，隨後向右偏出跑道，最後所有起落架均停在鬆軟地面。當地時間約為晚間8時19分，相當於11月21日01時19分 UTC。
報導未接獲人員受傷通報。來源記錄了事發時的氣象條件，但未確認偏出跑道的原因。

en.title: Aeroregional 737-500 veers off runway on landing in Ecuador
en.summary: Flight 6G-853 left the right side of the runway at Santa Rosa with 65 people aboard. No injuries were reported.
body: An Aeroregional Boeing 737-500 veered off the runway after landing at Santa Rosa in Ecuador on November 20, The Aviation Herald reported. Flight 6G-853 from Quito was operated by HC-CTF and had 65 people on board.
The aircraft landed on runway 25 during thunderstorms at about 8:19 p.m. local time. It veered to the right and stopped with all landing gear on soft ground.
The report said there were no reports of injuries. The source documented thunderstorms at the airport around the time of landing but did not establish the cause of the excursion.

facts.claim: HC-CTF left runway 25 at Santa Rosa after landing with 65 people on board.
The aircraft stopped with all landing gear on soft ground.
